args.body:
Dear Priya,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to confirm our dinner meeting scheduled for Friday, May 24, 2024, at 19:00 at The Gourmet Restaurant. The dinner is expected to run until 21:00.

Please let me know if this time and location still work for you and the team, or if any adjustments are needed.

We look forward to seeing you there and discussing our future collaboration.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
